name: ScholarshipOwl — How I Pay For School

cover.title:
HOW I PAY
FOR SCHOOL
cover.subtitle: A long-form YouTube sit-down plus campus interviews on how students *actually* afford college — with ScholarshipOwl as the answer. One month, one shoot, a library of assets you own.

concept.headline: The question every student is *already asking*
concept.body: Tuition is the number one thing students stress about — and almost nobody talks about it honestly. In this video I sit down and break down exactly how I pay for school: what I applied for, what worked, what didn't. Then I take the same question to campus and ask other students how they're covering it. ScholarshipOwl shows up the way it actually should — as the tool that answers the question, not as an ad read.

integration.headline: Six ways ScholarshipOwl *shows up*
placements: Sponsor tag at 0:00 — the first thing every viewer hears
Mid-video walkthrough — ScholarshipOwl on screen, actually being used
Woven into interviews — surfaced as the real answer, not a plug
Tracked link + code — description, pinned comment, and every clip
Full paid-ad rights — run the video and the clips as ads
Repurposing + collab posts — everything lives on your channels too
integration.callout: You own the output. Run it as paid media, post it to your own channels, and keep it working long after launch — plus collab posts that publish to both accounts at once.

distribution.headline: One shoot, *a month of assets*
distribution.blurb: The long-form feature lives on YouTube where it stays searchable all year. Cutdowns push the best interview moments across TikTok, Reels and Shorts as collab posts, so they land on both audiences at once. Every asset ships with full paid-ad rights — put spend behind whatever performs, and repost it all on your own channels.

numbers.headline: Built to *return the investment*
numbers.intro: Conservative projections. The engine is trust: students taking the answer from someone who actually went through it.
numbers.callout: Every dollar buys the video, the clips, the ad rights, and the repurposing — and the asset keeps converting every application season, not just at launch.

investment.headline: One month. *Three ways to run it.*
investment.cta: Every tier includes the same rights — the only difference is *how much content you get to run*. Greenlight by the week of Aug 17 to hold the mid-September launch.
